feedback: This is the first candidate, so there is no earlier race, outcome table or Evaluator Race Data to cite. The critique rests on the contract and the candidate's own contents. All geometry and controller values fall inside the contract limits. The sensors sit 0.05 m ahead of the axle, the sensor weights run -2 to 2 with the sign convention correct, and line_loss is one of the allowed options. Nothing is obviously broken. The main unknowns are whether base_speed 1.6 is fast enough for the 3.0 s limit without leaving the track on tight bends, and whether kp 2.0 with kd 0.3 oscillates. Only racing can show these. Once the race telemetry is in, change the controller as follows. If completion_time is above 3.0 s or progress is short, raise base_speed in steps of about 0.2. If max_error is above 0.03 m or the robot leaves the track on bends, lower base_speed first, and if the error persists lower kp. If steering_oscillation is high while rms_error is small, raise kd. If line_loss_events is above zero, consider changing line_loss to search_right or search_left, depending on which side the robot leaves the line.
requested_changes: If the race shows completion_time above 3.0 s or progress below 0.995, raise controller.base_speed in steps of about 0.2, while watching max_error.
If max_error exceeds about 0.03 m or the robot leaves the track on bends, lower controller.base_speed first, then lower controller.kp by about 0.3 if the error persists.

If steering_oscillation is high while rms_error is small, raise controller.kd from 0.3 toward 0.6. If line_loss_events is above zero, test controller.line_loss at search_left or search_right, matching the side the robot leaves the line.
